author: Arachadonic
body:
I have been told that diamonds have been removed from some maps already however one map I think they need to be removed from is Quintus (I think thats how its spelt). Frankly there are too many diamonds to start with so a lot of people can make plenty of armour/swords, secondly it is just too op. Even if you make iron armour it is still very very hard to kill the tanks wearing diamond armour. I don't really see the point in having that much diamond anyway in a map as it makes it unbalanced completely whereas everyone gets iron. 

Also no this isnt just me being a sore loser here. It is possible to kill them and I have of course it is just hard particularly if there are a group together spawn killing you. 
So I suggest they be limited or just taken out altogether.

Thanks!
